name: lionsbot
description: LionsBot mechanical team plugins for Claude Code: the PLM and the System Wiring Diagram's component database. Each asks for your own hub login.

plugins.name: system-diagram
plugins.description: Import a component datasheet into the ECDB: product photo, MPN, wires / terminals / built-in connectors with every pin's function. No ID; a person assigns it. Asks for your hub login once at install.

plugins.name: plm
plugins.description: The LionsBot PLM: SKU folders, component metadata, BOMs, and STEP/PDF upload by SKU. Asks for your hub / PLM login once at install. MCP server (npm plm-upload-mcp).
